description: This file defines the Data class used for managing custom data associated with DOM elements and other objects in jQuery. It provides methods to create, access, modify, and delete cached data, playing a central role in jQuery's internal data management system.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: A constructor function for creating cache instances that handle data storage for DOM nodes or JavaScript objects.

methods.name: cache( owner )
methods.description: Retrieves the cache object for a given owner; creates a new cache if none exists.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets data on an owner object, either via key-value pairs or an object of properties.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with an owner, either all data or for a specific key.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Unified method to get or set data depending on provided arguments.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes specified data keys from an owner object, and cleans up if no data remains.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks whether an owner object has any stored data.
